title: TriggerAwarePlayerBenchmarkManifest
description: Validation schema for Trigger-Aware Player ground-truth benchmark manifest (manifest.json). Enforces dataset provenance, temporal interval integrity, anti-leakage scene grouping, split allocation, and review statuses.

benchmark_id.description: Unique identifier for this benchmark release.

version.description: Semantic version of the benchmark dataset.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of benchmark manifest generation.

description.description: High-level description of the benchmark dataset and intended evaluation protocol.

clips.description: List of annotated or negative-control clips forming the benchmark.

event_id.description: Deterministic unique identifier for this event annotation.

start.description: Interval start presentation timestamp in seconds.

end.description: Interval end presentation timestamp in seconds. Must be strictly greater than start.

boundary_uncertainty_seconds.description: Estimated boundary uncertainty window in seconds (e.g. 0.05s).

annotator_id.description: Identifier of the human annotator, acoustic model, or synthetic generator.

review_status.description: Annotation verification status. Only 'verified' events may enter ground-truth scoring.

ambiguity_notes.description: Documentation of boundary ambiguity, acoustic overlap, or visual edge cases.

clip_id.description: Unique identifier for the benchmark clip.

film_id.description: Identifier for the source film, collection, or fixture.

media_relpath.description: Relative path from repository root to the playable media file.

duration_seconds.description: Total duration of the clip or media file in seconds.

fps.description: Video frame rate in frames per second, if applicable (0 for pure audio).

width.description: Video frame width in pixels, if applicable.

height.description: Video frame height in pixels, if applicable.

dataset_type.description: Provenance type: 'synthetic' for generated test fixtures, 'natural' for real media.

split.description: Dataset partition. Anti-leakage rules enforce disjoint scene_ids across splits.

scene_id.description: Scene or sequence cluster ID. Used to enforce scene-level separation across splits.

is_negative_control.description: True if this clip is an explicit negative control containing zero target trigger events.

negative_triggers.description: Optional list of specific trigger categories for which this clip is an explicit negative control. If omitted, applies to modality-appropriate canonical triggers.

license.description: License or provenance attribution for media rights integrity.

events.description: Annotated trigger intervals within this clip.
